card.name: Screening-related findings in cancer warnings
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word naming a screening finding or precancerous condition, such as 'mammograms' after 'abnormal mamm', 'proliferative' breast conditions, or 'polyps'. It also fires on 'lesions' after 'suspicious skin'.
